title: Meetings
desc: Governance → Meetings (list, distinct from the scheduler)
structure:
Standard .sidebar with Governance carrying .active; .side-foot shows sf-avatar "DS", sf-name "Delroy Samuels", sf-role "Secretary". The .topbar has

Meetings

then a .top-right containing a single .btn-primary-sm with a plus svg (path "M12 5v14M5 12h14") and Schedule meeting; no back chevron. The .content holds two blocks. First a .subnav (navy-100 pill container, width:fit-content, margin-bottom:18px) with three .subnav-item: "Notices", "Meetings" carrying .active, "Elections". Second a full-width whose thead row has six
: "Meeting", "Type", "Date", "Audience", "Quorum" and one empty th for the row-action column. The tbody has five rows, in this order: (1) "AGM 2026" | "AGM" | "Sat, Sep 27 · 10:00 AM" | "Whole estate" | .status-badge.upcoming "Not yet met" | .text-link-sm "View agenda"; (2) "Phase 2 boundary wall discussion" | "Phase meeting" | "Sat, Oct 4 · 2:00 PM" | "Phase 2 only" | .status-badge.upcoming "Not yet met" | .text-link-sm "View agenda"; (3) "Executive Committee — September" | "Committee" | "Sep 8, 2026" | "Committee members" | .status-badge.done "Quorum met · 6/7" | .text-link-sm "View minutes"; (4) "EGM — Security budget increase" | "EGM" | "Jul 19, 2026" | "Whole estate" | .status-badge.done "Quorum met · 34%" | .text-link-sm "View minutes"; (5) "AGM 2025" | "AGM" | "Sep 21, 2025" | "Whole estate" | .status-badge.done "Quorum met · 41%" | .text-link-sm "View minutes". Badges are wrapped in a div inside the td, as are the text links. No cards, no charts, no empty state, no pagination.
domain_needs: meeting.title — "AGM 2026", "Phase 2 boundary wall discussion", "Executive Committee — September", "EGM — Security budget increase", "AGM 2025"

meeting.starts_at — two distinct display formats: upcoming meetings show weekday + date + middot + time ("Sat, Sep 27 · 10:00 AM", "Sat, Oct 4 · 2:00 PM") while past meetings show date only ("Sep 8, 2026", "Jul 19, 2026", "Sep 21, 2025") — implies a rendering rule keyed off whether the meeting is upcoming or held
meeting.audience — "Whole estate", "Phase 2 only", "Committee members"; when phase-scoped it needs meeting.phase_id (Phase 2)
meeting.quorum_status — enum driving badge class: "Not yet met" (.upcoming, amber) vs "Quorum met" (.done, green)

meeting.quorum_display — two different measures: a head count ratio "6/7" for committee meetings (attendees_present / committee_members_total, DERIVED) and a percentage "34%" / "41%" for estate-wide meetings (units represented / total units, DERIVED)
meeting.status distinguishing upcoming (agenda exists, minutes do not) from held (minutes exist) — drives the row action label "View agenda" vs "View minutes"
meeting_agenda entity (agenda items linked to a meeting) and meeting_minutes entity (minutes document linked to a held meeting)
list sort order — the rows run upcoming-soonest-first then past newest-first: Sep 27 2026, Oct 4 2026, Sep 8 2026, Jul 19 2026, Sep 21 2025; a sort on status then date
governance subnav sections: Notices, Meetings, Elections with sort order and active flag
"Schedule meeting" action routes to the separate scheduler form (a distinct screen from this list)
